title: Complaint filed, probe into stalled Naga City Convention Center pushed

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Anti-Corruption Czar (PACC), a civil society watchdog, filed a complaint-affidavit before the Office of the Ombudsman on Thursday in connection with the P600-million Naga City Convention Center. PACC National Chairman Dr. Louie Ceniza said they lodged the complaint to urge the Ombudsman to investigate the unfinished project in Brgy. Carolina.
